__domains__.thermal: Heat transfer: conduction and convection resistances, Nusselt correlations, lumped heating, plastic and friction heating
__domains__.aero: Air properties and aerodynamics: atmosphere, Reynolds and Mach numbers, drag, lift, windage, propeller and hover thrust
__domains__.diagnostics: Checking and reporting sims: energy ledgers, time step convergence, verification, failure modes, load pulses, reports
__domains__.integrators: Time stepping: explicit step schemes, a fixed step driver, and stable time step size estimates
__domains__.geometry: Part shapes and contact geometry: outlines from images, DXF or bars, and spinner first contact angles
__domains__.structures: Beams, plates, rings, columns, bolts, sections and fatigue: closed-form strength and stiffness answers
__domains__.materials: Material library and curves: properties by name, stress-strain curves, composite layups and lamina cards
__domains__.contact: Contact stiffness and impact: Hertz contact, effective modulus and radius, penalty and restitution estimates
__domains__.friction: Friction and tires: Coulomb and slip-curve models for sliding, wheels and traction
__domains__.rigid_body: Mass properties and rigid-body dynamics: inertia of shapes, assemblies, spin, gyroscopic and impact transfer
__domains__.actuators: Motors, ESCs and batteries: motor constants from curves, spin-up time, battery sag
__domains__.constitutive: Material laws for elements: elastic, plastic and hyperelastic force tables
